summary: Preimplementation harness audit complete. A fail-closed PR-173 certifier is viable if the frozen spec separates rank resolution from estimator-unit MC uncertainty, uses dependence-aware uncertainty methods, verifies each small source artifact against an external pinned root while inheriting raw-input hashes without reopening payloads, and keeps process success distinct from the two numerical-resolution outcomes. No production or shared file was edited.

findings.verdict: A unit-safe registered decision contract is required; dimensionless rank resolution cannot be directly combined with dimensional RMSE or band-power uncertainty.
Uncertainty dispatch must be estimator- and dependence-specific; the PR-150 noise-reuse fixture forbids iid binomial treatment.
Hash reuse requires an externally frozen source root; inherited raw-input hashes may be reused only after that small source artifact verifies.
Finite-rank certificates must be count-native and preserve p=(1+b)/(N+1); ranked rows, clusters, and bootstrap replicates are distinct roles.
Process success and numerical resolution are orthogonal; unresolved is a valid certificate outcome, while integrity/method failures emit no numerical label.
Numerical certification must inherit upstream claim and validation boundaries; the ACT fixture remains exploratory outside its released validation range.
Boundary-safe intervals and strict numeric parsing are required; plug-in zero SE, NaN, infinity, boolean counts, empty vectors, and nonpositive N must fail closed.

result_envelope.claim_verdict: A closed, typed design can satisfy the PR-173 card, but a generic scalar rule such as estimate versus max(MC_SE, 1/(N+1)) is invalid. The spec must freeze estimator kind, dependence model, decision boundary, uncertainty method, confidence level, and unit-safe status rule before implementation.

architecture: Use a small OBSSTAT certifier with closed adapters for pinned upstream summary schemas rather than rescanning raw simulations.

Read and hash each small source JSON in one pass against a root hash frozen outside that source. Once the root matches, copy its ordered inherited input-hash ledger verbatim and never open those inherited payload paths.
Normalize every finite rank to integer fields rank_numerator, exceedance_count, n_null, and denominator=n_null+1. Derive the displayed float only from those integers.

Dispatch MC uncertainty by estimator_kind and dependence_kind. Finite rank or tail proportion, continuous mean, RMSE, quantile/tail, and cluster-dependent summaries require distinct registered methods.

Evaluate a preregistered decision contract. RESOLVED_WITHIN_REGISTERED_MC_CONTRACT means the entire certified uncertainty set lies on one side of the registered boundary in compatible units. Any overlap yields NUMERICALLY_UNRESOLVED_AT_CURRENT_MC_BUDGET.
Treat the two numerical labels as successful certificate outcomes. Hash/schema/method/dependence failures produce no numerical label and fail or block the process envelope.

Publish a deterministic write/check result pack whose config hash covers adapter version, source roots, estimator/dependence kinds, boundary, direction, confidence level, uncertainty algorithm, resampling seed, and rank tie policy.
unit_safe_status_rules: For a rank or tail-probability decision against alpha, compare a registered probability-scale interval and the discrete rank cell to alpha; do not rely on a plug-in SE alone at b=0 or b=N.

For a continuous metric such as band power or RMSE, compare an estimator-unit interval to an estimator-unit boundary. Report 1/(N+1) separately as probability-rank resolution; never add or maximize it with a dimensional SE unless a registered map to probability units exists.
If no decision boundary was frozen, emit a valid certificate with numerical decision status withheld or unresolved; do not invent a conventional threshold after seeing the value.

source_fixture_audit.forbidden_route: Do not use 999 as iid binomial units, 300 as the rank denominator, or 20000 bootstrap replicates as either rank or independent scientific units.
Do not use 401 as n_null, erase the outside-validation boundary, or turn numerical resolution into ACT validation.

harness_findings.verdict: The card's overlap language is not executable until each metric has a preregistered boundary, direction, units, estimator kind, and confidence rule. Rank resolution is dimensionless; RMSE and band-power uncertainty are dimensional. A generic max or sum is a unit error.
harness_findings.required_action: Freeze a typed decision contract per metric and an explicit not-applicable/withheld route when no probability-rank channel or boundary exists.

harness_findings.verdict: MC uncertainty cannot use one formula across the target set. The PR-150 rank explicitly disclaims iid/exact exchangeability because 999 CMB rows reuse 300 noise maps; its 20000 bootstrap resamples are computation, not independent ensemble size. PR-152 supplies 400 exchangeable release simulations and a continuous band-power vector, so it supports a different route.
harness_findings.required_action: Use closed estimator_kind and dependence_kind dispatch. Reject iid/binomial certification when the source disclaims it, unless an independently registered dependence-aware uncertainty record is present.

harness_findings.verdict: Hash reuse is safe only through an external trust root. A hash declared by the same mutable source is not authentication. The certifier should hash each small source JSON once, compare to a spec-pinned root, then inherit its ordered input_hashes without reading those raw paths.
harness_findings.required_action: Pin source path, source SHA-256, source schema, and adapter version in the frozen PR-173 config/spec; include the source root and inherited ledger in the output manifest; reject conflicts, omissions, malformed digests, or runtime self-resealing.

harness_findings.verdict: Finite-rank values must be count-native. PR-135 fixes p=(1+b)/(N+1), conservative ties, and floor 1/(N+1). PR-152 has direct b=145 and N=400; PR-150 has N=999 and a grid value 39/1000 but no top-level b. Float-first reconstruction or confusing N with N+1, unique clusters, or bootstrap replicates creates false precision.
harness_findings.required_action: Require integer numerator/count/denominator in new certificates. For the legacy PR-150 adapter, reconstruct the unique nearest numerator only under a strict on-grid check bound to the pinned source root; do not generalize float tolerance as authority.

harness_findings.verdict: Process status and numerical resolution status must remain orthogonal. NUMERICALLY_UNRESOLVED_AT_CURRENT_MC_BUDGET is an allowed terminal scientific/numerical outcome, while hash mismatch, schema drift, unsupported uncertainty, or missing dependence evidence is a process failure and must not be relabeled unresolved.
harness_findings.required_action: Let PR-173 complete when the infrastructure and required certificates execute correctly even if one or all numerical outcomes are unresolved. Downstream requires_success edges mean the certifier is available, not that every metric is resolved; consumers must inspect the certificate status.

harness_findings.verdict: Numerical certification must preserve upstream validation boundaries and caveats. The ACT source is explicitly outside the released spectrum validation range. A resolved MC contract cannot promote it to validated data or physics.
harness_findings.required_action: Copy claim tier, validation boundary, transfer/null/covariance status, caveats, and forbidden uses into every certificate and lint against physical validation language.

harness_findings.verdict: A plug-in MC SE is unsafe at tail boundaries and JSON numeric parsing must be fail-closed. b=0 can produce a misleading zero plug-in SE even though finite resolution is poorest; NaN, infinity, booleans-as-counts, empty vectors, and nonpositive N must be rejected before status evaluation.
harness_findings.required_action: Require finite numeric payloads and positive integer counts, and use a registered interval with boundary-safe behavior for finite proportions in addition to any displayed standard error.

routing: Mark PR-173 completed only after deterministic write/check, mutation kills, status/DAG validation, and independent review.
A valid unresolved certificate is terminal and does not make the infrastructure PR fail.
A source-integrity, schema, unsupported-method, or missing-dependence failure emits no certificate status and blocks/fails closeout.
Downstream requires_success consumers are unblocked by a successful certifier PR but must explicitly reject or downroute unresolved certificates according to their own kill switches.

assumptions: This is a preimplementation audit; no PR-173 spec, implementation, test file, result pack, or status mutation was included in the assignment evidence slice.
The required-input hashes and live context version were verified before substantive work.

The no-repeated-full-byte-hashing requirement is interpreted as no reopening/re-hashing inherited raw ensemble payloads; hashing the 5.3 KiB and 14.1 KiB source summary artifacts once per run is the external-root verification step.
No decision threshold was inferred from the observed source values. Any threshold, including 0.05, must be frozen by the main writer before resolution status is computed.
